newsitem.title: USA: 15 arrested in clampdown on border drug gang.
newsitem.headline: 15 arrested in clampdown on border drug gang.

text.p: Raids on two used car lots authorities said were fronts for a multimillion-dollar drug smuggling operation on the U.S.-Mexico border have led to 15 arrests, an official said Tuesday.
FBI spokesman Al Cruz said the lots were used to launder drug money and smuggle drugs across the Rio Grande and into the southwest Texas border town of El Paso.
Cruz said the operation to bust the smuggling ring began last week and was continuing, adding that the drug gang handled about $35 million of drugs per year.
He said the used car lots received marijuana and cocaine in El Paso and then moved them across the United States by putting them in special compartments inside vehicles.
Nine of the 15 people arrested were from El Paso and the remaining six from Washington. Cruz said more arrests were expected.
